metaDescription: Order custom Popl golf polo shirts for your team. Perfect for corporate events, golf outings, and brand promotion. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Popl golf polo shirts combine the performance fabrics you expect from top athletic brands with the convenience of a built-in digital business card. Each shirt features a Popl NFC tag or QR code sewn into the placket, allowing wearers to share contact info, social links, and more with a simple tap or scan. For marketing directors and sales teams, these polos turn every handshake and networking moment into an instant connection. Choose from moisture-wicking styles like the Nike Golf Tech Dri Fit or Sport Tek Micropique, and add your logo to create a uniform that works as hard as your team.
heroAltText: Custom Popl golf polo shirt with NFC tag for sharing digital business cards
